Hero.description: I'm Seydullah, a computer engineer and freelance software developer based in Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye. From business websites to web and mobile apps, I turn your idea into fast, reliable and maintainable products.

About.title: Solid engineering, simple products.
paragraphs: I'm a computer engineer based in Kahramanmaraş, building web and mobile products for businesses in Kahramanmaraş and across Türkiye. Before writing any code, I make sure I understand your business and your users, then choose the architecture and technology that fit those needs.

I write readable, type-safe and testable code, and I treat performance and security as requirements from day one. After launch I stay on board, keeping the product growing with maintenance and new features.
About.workStyleNote: I usually reply to messages within 24 hours.

Services.description: From a single landing page to a full-scale application, I support you at every stage.
